title: "Reduction to Degree-3 Bolean gaps"
bibliography: refs.bib
---

Let $C$ be a quantum circuit on $l$ qubits consisting of Hadamard, Z, CZ and CCZ gates,
starting and ending with a column of Hadamard gates,
and containing $h$ internal Hadamard gates. 
Then the exists a Boolean function $f_C(y)$ such that $G(C,y):= f_C(y)$ is polynomial-time computable Boolean predicate and
$$
\langle 0|C|0\rangle = \frac{\mathrm{gap}(f_C)}{2^{l + h/2}}
$$
